cases.submission: Derived matrix and all numerical work, no structural investigation at all

cases.submission: Omitted parallel-direction exception but all concrete work and general derivation correct

cases.mathematicalRationale: Shape labels do not supply the specified LGS method.

cases.mathematicalRationale: One local failure does not trigger the core-action cap.

cases.mathematicalRationale: One local calculation error is not wholesale loss of a target application.

cases.submission: Incorrect 3t instead of 3|t| but otherwise complete

cases.submission: Omitted degenerate t=0 reasoning but all other work correct

limitations: Award allocations and cap judgments are explicit author interpretations of the rubric, not an automated semantic marking system or independent approval. One ordinary total only; no side evidence, sub-passes or prerequisite mastery.
